text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: Sev2 - multi-gpu collective failures on dedicated pool 'tp4-prod-02'. Pager ID: P-9432. Symptoms: repeated NCCL AllReduce hangs + container exit code 137 on tensor-pipeline workloads; 2 nodes reporting OOM kills and one node reporting repeated CUDA 'invalid device function' errors. Affected customers: 1 high-traffic inference tenant (tenant: acme-vision), multiple background batch jobs.

oncall-robert: Acknowledged. I'm on it. tagging mlinfra-miguel and sre-jen. Robert here, will start triage and coordinate mitigation. Can someone grab NVML and pod logs?

mlinfra-miguel: grabbing logs from nodes 10.240.3.12 and 10.240.3.15 now. Posting snapshots.

mlinfra-miguel: kubectl -n prod logs tp-job-7-pt-3 -c runtime --tail=200
```
[2026-03-15T14:21:12Z] runtime: NCCL WARN AllReduce timed out after 120s
[2026-03-15T14:21:13Z] containerd: signal: killed (OOM)
[2026-03-15T14:21:13Z] runtime: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH: kernel launch failed, errno=700
```

mlinfra-miguel: nv-smi snapshot (node 10.240.3.12):
```
GPU 0: 99% mem, processes: python(ode 1), python(ode 2)
GPU 1: 98% mem
Total GPU memory pressure: >95%
```

sre-jen: dmesg from node 10.240.3.12 shows OOM killer invoked and Docker container PID killed. Also seeing repeated 'nvidia: GPU watchdog timeout' messages.

engineer-sara: This looks like TP/PP pipeline stage that pins a full model shard per device. If KV cache + activations spike, OOM is plausible. Short-term mitigation: set environment to reduce memory usage and disable IB to see if NCCL fabric is exacerbating it. Suggest exports:
```
NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1
NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PXB
PYTORCH_JIT_DISABLE=1
```
Also can we reduce batch_size to 1 for in-flight jobs and respin pods?

sre-jen: I'm going to cordon node 10.240.3.12 and drain non-critical pods. Will patch runtime config for the job to set NCCL envs and restart.

sre-jen: kubectl cordon node/10.240.3.12
```
node/10.240.3.12 cordoned
```

sre-jen: kubectl drain node/10.240.3.12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
pod "tp-job-7-pt-3" evicted
pod "monitor-agent" evicted
```

mlinfra-miguel: Applied emergency patch on deployment tp-pipeline-prod: set env vars (NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1, NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PXB), reduced BATCH_SIZE from 8 -> 2 and set MAX_SEQ_LEN to 1024. Rolling restart initiated.

mlinfra-miguel: After restart, new pods attached to node 10.240.3.15 and 10.240.3.16. Early signs: NCCL messages now missing the timeout line; GPU memory usage is 78% max.

support-amy: Support update: acme-vision reported 503 spikes on /v1/infer since 14:18 UTC, error rate ~30%. They are on a dedicated capacity plan; they're escalated to SEs. I'm drafting a status note.

support-amy: Draft to customer:
"We observed a transient multi-GPU runtime issue impacting inference endpoints between 14:18 and 14:40 UTC. We applied mitigations (node drain, NCCL fabric change, reduced batch size) and services are recovering. We'll follow up with a root-cause update." :writing_hand: 

oncall-robert: Good. Documenting timeline. Assigning temporary incident owner: mlinfra-miguel. Postmortem owner: engineer-sara.

mlinfra-miguel: Confirming mitigations held for 20m, queued jobs not failing. I'll run a focused repro to see if kernel launch errors persist and collect nvlist + core dump if we see another crash.

engineer-sara: Next steps for RCA: collect CUDA logs, kernel traces, NCCL debug logs (set NCCL_DEBUG=INFO/TRACE on repro), check for driver mismatch across nodes and check container memory accounting (cgroup limits). Also evaluate if model sharding can be rebalanced to avoid two heavily loaded GPUs on the same node.

sre-jen: Note: we saw one container exit code 137 and one container with 'invalid device function'. I'm opening host-level ticket to audit driver versions and do kernel upgrade plan if needed.

oncall-robert: Handing off to night on-call @oncall-oliver at 15:05 UTC — oncall-oliver you have the keys. Please watch the acme-vision endpoint and escalate if error rate >10% persists. I'll update the incident page with links to logs and mitigation steps.

oncall-oliver: Ack. I'll take over. Please leave notes on which nodes were cordoned and which deployments patched. :eyes: 

mlinfra-miguel: Nodes cordoned: 10.240.3.12. Patched deployments: tp-pipeline-prod (env overrides + batch size). Rolling restarts completed at 14:40 UTC.

support-amy: Customer notified. SE assigned to keep them updated.

engineer-sara: I'll own the postmortem writeup. Tentative RCA hypothesis: combined effect of peak activation memory + driver/kernel interaction causing GPU watchdog resets → NCCL communicators hang → OOM kills. Will confirm with traces.

incident-bot: Incident P-9432 acknowledged closed to active mitigation stage; severity downgraded to Sev3 as error rates dropped below 5% for 15 minutes. Follow-up: postmortem due in 72h, owner: engineer-sara. :white_check_mark: 

oncall-oliver: Closing out handoff notes. Leaving monitoring alert set for 24h to catch regressions. :lock: 

sre-jen: If any regression, immediate plan is: 1) re-enable IB only after driver/firmware validation, 2) keep NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 in the short window, 3) consider node reprovision with consistent driver version.

engineer-sara: thanks everyone. I'll post the draft RCA in #postmortems and sync with SE/support for customer-facing details.
